ruleDefinitions.name: Rundll32 InstallScreenSaver Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: An attacker may execute an application as a SCR File using rundll32.exe desk.cpl,InstallScreenSaver

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "RUNDLL32\.EXE") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*InstallScreenSaver.*"))
